title: Reaching high notes and testing them before playing
summary: He says his fingers know what comes next and describes testing a high note and adjusting the reed beforehand.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: What about these real high notes, that, that, is there any difficulty in getting those real high notes?

Well, I'll tell you something here, with me, you know. I, I don't read, I imagine my fingers know what it's gonna do, before it gets up here. Say it, sorry? My fingers, feel that, it know what it's going to do, before it gets up here,
I can tell when I can't make a high note, do it. I, and I feel that way, that I can't make it, I don't make it, I don't try for it.

I always try, before I play, I'll make that high note, before I start, I'll run, I'll make an IG, or, or whatever note. And if I can't hit it, then I'll pull my reed, dial, you know, to make it a little stiffer. If I can't get it that way, I'll change the reed.
